helpNitrogen: Drives leaf and stem growth. Too little makes leaves pale yellow.
helpPhosphorus: Builds roots and helps grain fill. Low P stunts young plants.
helpPotassium: Strengthens stems and improves drought and disease tolerance.
helpPh: Acidity. Most crops do best between 6.0 and 7.5.
helpOrganic: Rotted plant matter. Holds water and nutrients; above 0.75% is good.
helpMoisture: Water in the soil at sampling time. Affects how fast nutrients move.
helpSulfur: Needed for protein and oil formation in crops.
helpCopper: A micronutrient needed in small amounts for enzyme activity.
helpIron: Needed for chlorophyll formation; deficiency causes yellowing.
helpZinc: A common deficiency in Indian soils; affects grain yield.
helpBoron: Needed for flowering and fruit or seed development.
